While the study uses three different cell lines (HK-2, NCM460D, Caco-2), these are treated as different biological contexts for the same perturbation (S1 interaction) rather than a differential treatment variable in the traditional sense. Mapping to 'ligand_stimulation' is used as the S1 domain acts as a ligand for host receptors.
